Consular help:Consular help will be provided bythe Embassy of Bosnia and Herzegovina in New Delhi, India.
Visa required for the following traveling documentation for BH citizens:
Regular passport YES Visa shall be issued in Vienna
Regular biometric passport YES
Service/Official biometric passport YES
Diplomatic biometric passport YES
Holders of diplomatic and official travel documents of Bosnia and Herzegovina require visas when entering Sri Lanka.
With effect from 15 October 2025, all travelers visiting Sri Lanka for tourism and business purposes are required to obtain an Electronic Travel Authorization (ETA) via the official website: eta.gov.lk
Contact Embassy of Democratic Socialist Republic of SRI LANKA in Vienna:
Address: Weyringergasse 33, 4th Floor, 1040-Vienna, AustriaTel: 0043 1 503 7988Fax: 0043 1 503 7993Mail: embassy@srilankaembassy.atCitizens of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka are required visas when entering, exiting or travelling through Bosnia and Herzegovina. Visa shall be issued in New Delhi, India.
